bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · testing the Sep 15 low
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 测试 9月15日低点

read.en: TSMC fell 2.3% on Oct 16 to $412.61 on heavy volume and is down 9% in five sessions. It is below the 100-day ($430.2, rising), 5-day ($430.9), 30-day ($444.3) and 10-day ($450.6) averages and above the rising 200-day ($395.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and has slipped below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($466.06), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: 台积电 10月16日放量下跌 2.3%，收于 $412.61，五个交易日累计下跌 9%。股价位于 100 日（$430.2，上行）、5 日（$430.9）、30 日（$444.3）和 10 日均线（$450.6）下方，位于上行的 200 日均线（$395.1）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，并已跌至零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$466.06），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The day's low of $410.58 undercut the $412.5 Sep 15 low, and the close held just above it. Resistance is $430–431 (100 and 5-day averages), then $444 (30-day average, Sep 8 high) and $450.6 (10-day). Support is $412.5, then $405–408 (Aug 24 and Sep 3 lows, Oct 15 low $407.1) and $395 (200-day average). A close below $405 would open $395.

s.en: Aug 24 and Sep 3 lows ($405–408); Oct 15 low $407.1
